description: A front end for chatting and roleplaying with AI models and characters.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of SillyTavern 1.18.0, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Talks to whichever AI service you connect it to — a local model or a provider's API — with keys it keeps in its data folder.
Open by default, with no login: anyone who can reach the address can use it. Its IP whitelist stays on, widened to Docker's own networks so the page reaches it through the port mapping.
Characters and extensions you import come from other people; extensions are code that runs in the app.
